quotes.text: `commands/readme.mjs` generates README branding (`node tb.mjs readme`). `commands/graph/templates.mjs` generates launcher/console markup, and `commands/graph/server.mjs` serves `/favicon.ico`, `/assets/branding/app-icon.png`, `/assets/branding/logo-light.png`, and `/assets/branding/logo-dark.png`. [Task 1]
